title: State Scholarship Classes 6-10
eligibility: Scheduled Caste students who are regular students of a recognized institution
benefits: Official record states INR 200 per year for boys and INR 600 for girls for 10 months
documents_required: Required documents are to be submitted to the concerned educational institution
application_process: Submit the application with required documents to the concerned educational institution
important_sections_or_clauses: Official record states payment through the Samagra Education Portal/one-click process.
source_type: Official Government of Madhya Pradesh CM Helpline Scheme Dashboard
